sloka: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानिनिष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः ।प्रच्चन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते ॥५-१-८२॥
transliteration: praviśannabhrajālāniniṣpataṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ।praccannaśca prakāśaśca candramā iva lakṣyate ॥5-1-82॥

translations.english: Entering into and emerging from the clouds, he looked like the Moon that appears and disappears (behind a bank of clouds).
